text: 27. Woe to you, blind guides, who say, `Whoever swears by the temple, that is...

Woe to you, blind guides, who say, `Whoever swears by the temple, that is nothing; but whoever swears by the gold of the temple is obligated.' You fools and blind men! Whoever swears by the temple, swears both by the temple and by God Who dwells within it. Matt. 23: 16-22
